settings.content: Colours, type and spacing come from the design system in mts-theme.css and are deliberately not editable here — changing them piecemeal is how a considered palette turns into a generic one. The brand colour below only feeds the browser theme-colour meta tag.

settings.label: Logo (dark header)
settings.info: Leave empty to use the packaged logo. 196×34 renders 1:1.

settings.label: Intro splash on first visit
settings.info: A 0.9s logo title card, shown once per session. Skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Home page meta description
settings.info: Used only when Online Store > Preferences has none. Aim for 150-160 characters.
settings.default: Shop premium adhesive tapes online at My Tape Store. Double-sided, foam, foil, masking, packaging and safety tapes — trade-grade brands, fast Australia-wide delivery.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: In dollars. Drives the progress bar on the cart page.

settings.content: Each product's price breaks come from its own mts.volume_tiers metafield, scraped from mytapestore.com.au by scripts/push_tiers.py — 81 of 131 products have them, in nine different shapes. Products without the metafield show nothing. Re-run that script whenever the breaks change on the original store.

IMPORTANT: the theme only DISPLAYS these prices. Nothing discounts the cart yet, so until a matching discount is live in Shopify Admin → Discounts, the table is a price guide, not a promise. Turn it off below if that gap is a problem.

settings.label: Default collection banner
settings.info: Used only by collections with no banner of their own — including /collections/all, which Shopify generates without a collection record.

settings.label: Show the wishlist heart
settings.info: Wishlists are stored in the browser only — they do not sync to a customer account.

settings.label: Bestseller tag
settings.info: Products carrying this tag show the Bestseller badge.

settings.label: Don't show again for
settings.info: After someone dismisses it. A successful signup hides it permanently.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: New stock, bulk pricing and the occasional job-site tip. Unsubscribe anytime.

settings.label: Chat backend
settings.info: SmartBot needs its app embed switched on for this theme (Customize → App embeds). If it never loads, the button falls back to the built-in assistant so there is always a working chat.

settings.label: Show SmartBot's pop-up greeting
settings.info: SmartBot's unprompted bubble follows the shopper between pages and covers product cards.

settings.content: Storefront API token for the themed sign-in. This token is PUBLIC by design — it is meant to be read by the browser and grants only unauthenticated storefront access. It is not the Admin token and must never be replaced with one.

settings.label: Storefront API access token
settings.info: Admin > Apps > your app > API credentials > Storefront API access token.

settings.label: Use the themed sign-in form
settings.info: Off = hand off to Shopify's hosted sign-in. On = sign in on this site. Note: a themed session does NOT carry into checkout.
